Name: The Limey Dragon Movie
Author: TheLimeyDragon
Description:
[size=3]A brand new movie for the Movie Theatre, "The Limey Dragon". a family,comedy,sci-fi film.

The film will show up every Summer on years: 2,5,8,11,14,etc by default. Sharing the season with any other films showing.
However there is a config option where you can adjust this. (I also included an image to understand the settings).

Currently all the NPC reactions are mostly vanilla, until I can try to fiddle with them more.[/size]
[b]

[size=4][u]Tastes[/u][/size] [/b](as of version 1.1.0, some may change in the future)[b]

[/b][size=3]Dislike: [spoiler]Sebastian, Shane, Krobus, Wizard, Haley, Linus, George, Dwarf[/spoiler]
Love: [spoiler]Abigail, Sam, Leah, Vincent, Jas, Caroline[/spoiler]
Like: Everyone else.
[/size]
[b]
[u][size=4]Note for other mod authors
[/size][/u][/b]
Assuming you use the movie ids as tags for when you set taste/reaction preferences, this movie uses: [code]TheLimeyDragon.Movie_Summer1[/code]

The film also has the follow ResponsePoints which you can use as the reaction point for 'during the film'.
(As far as I am aware you can only use 1 by default.)

--------------------------------------------------------------

[code]TLDAd1 - Joja Cola ad
TLDAd2 - Washing powder ad
TLDAd3 - Mount Vapius ad
TLDSoon - Film trailers start
TLDNWO - Natural Wonders: Ocean trailer
TLDPK2 - Prairie King II trailer
TLDStart - The movie starts
TLDDragon - The Limey Dragon introduced
TLDBANG - Comet crash/Loud bang
TLDAlien - The alien shows up
TLDAdventure1 - The adventure begins
TLDAdventure2 - The adventure continues
TLDAdventure3 - The adventure continues more
TLDSad - Sad Goodbye
TLDEnd - The End
TLDCredits - Credits roll
[/code]
